title: Navimower 0.4.2

## Highlights

Navimower 0.4.2 is the cumulative stable release of the 0.4.2 beta line. It is built directly on 0.4.1 and already contains all beta1-beta7 changes; no beta release needs to be installed first.

### Notifications and mower activity timeline

- Adds a persistent Navimower-local notification center alongside the vendor Device notification feed. The newest 10 vendor rows and up to 20 retained local rows are merged newest-first for the Latest notification sensor.
- Adds confirmed local notifications for Home Assistant Mow/Resume/Dock actions, conservative scheduled-task attribution, external mowing starts, night/sunrise interruption and continuation, charging interruption/continuation and unambiguous 100% completion.
- Adds `navimower.mark_notification_read` and `navimower.mark_all_notifications_read`. Local notification read state is stored by Navimower; vendor rows use the recovered Navimow message-read contracts and refresh the vendor feed instead of faking state locally.
- Local notification generation and local Mark as read were field-tested during the beta line. Inference-based night/charging attribution remains deliberately conservative and can be refined later from real diagnostics if a firmware reports a different transition pattern.

### Resume and mowing control

- Adds the dedicated `navimower.resume` action using the retained-task private-cloud Resume command. Resume sends no zone list, does not reset mowing progress and does not create a new local mowing cycle.
- The paused `lawn_mower.start_mowing` path uses the same Resume helper. Normal Mow remains the explicit new/restart-task path.

### Schedule correctness

- Fixes zone-restricted schedule writes so every selected zone id is encoded as little-endian uint16 in `partitionPlan`, matching official-app captures.
- Prevents shifted schedule payloads that could drop selected zones, corrupt later periods or create a phantom `00:15-00:15` period.
- Existing schedule master-switch behavior is preserved; the 0.4.2 beta work did not replace the already-working master On/Off path.

### Regional private-cloud routing

- Private-cloud login no longer assumes every account belongs to the FRA passport service. Navimower resolves the account region before password authentication and supports the observed Europe (`fra`/`eu`), Asia-Pacific (`sg`/`sea`), Americas (`us`/`ore`) and mainland China (`bj`) routes.
- The mower-cloud client probes the bounded host candidates for the resolved account region, retains the first usable host and persists it in the Home Assistant config entry.
- Official Smart Home OAuth/MQTT remains independent from the private mobile-app cloud region. MQTT continues to use the broker details returned by the official Smart Home API (`mqttHost` / `mqttUrl`).

> [!NOTE]
> The regional routing implementation follows field evidence from `ilguala/navimow_pro`, including the observed US `ore` account using the FRA mower-cloud host. Non-European region paths were not locally hardware-tested before this stable release; future user diagnostics can refine the routing table if Segway changes or expands its topology.

### Capability evidence and model support

- Adds an evidence-first capability profile to parsed mower snapshots and Download diagnostics. It records endpoint presence, reported setting key paths, positively observed feature groups and narrow proven model-family constraints.
- Missing or empty data in one poll is not treated as proof that a mower lacks a feature. Existing switch/number/select provisioning remains field/presence-driven, while the capability profile provides a safer base for future sensor provisioning across H, i and X families.
- The 0.4.2 beta line was exercised on H2- and X3-series mowers for the functionality available on those test devices.

### Download diagnostics

Home Assistant **Download diagnostics** remains the supported support interface and is intentionally information-rich while sanitized and read-only. It includes:

- sanitized config-entry data/options;
- mower/model/state/problem context;
- private-cloud, OAuth and MQTT connectivity/recovery context;
- resolved private-cloud region/host routing;
- the evidence-first capability profile and reported setting key paths;
- positioning, telemetry, coverage and settings context;
- map summary/zone details, retained history/cycle context and problem history;
- vendor/local notification context plus notification-center state;
- private-cloud polling health, MQTT health and the sanitized raw private-cloud snapshot.

Tokens, passwords, account identifiers, mower serial/device identifiers, network identifiers and physical GPS coordinates are redacted. Relative local-map X/Y geometry may remain because it is needed for map/navigation support and is not a physical GPS coordinate. Downloading diagnostics makes no additional vendor requests and never executes Resume or notification mutation actions.

### Production-source cleanup

- Removes the deprecated Legacy Map Camera; Navimower Map Card is the supported map UI.
- Replaces accumulated beta-numbered runtime modules with responsibility-based semantic modules and one explicit `runtime.py` composition point.
- Adds a permanent architecture regression guard so future betas do not reintroduce release-numbered production runtime layers. Git tags and release notes keep release history; production module names describe responsibility.

### Compatibility

- Existing config entries, mower entities, map/session storage and notification storage are retained.
- Existing European accounts continue to resolve to the same FRA private-cloud route.
- No 0.4.2 beta needs to be installed before this release.
